claims.title: Division free selected pair Green reachability obstruction
claims.result: Reachability implies rank at most three for the explicit four-column matrix. Nonzero exact minors exclude the pinned seed-19 Fourier targets at N=4,16,64,256, including the explicit integer/rational characteristic-zero lifts.
claims.limits: Only input pi1 and output pi3 vary; six terms, coefficients and topology remain fixed. Necessary condition only. No unrestricted architecture, all-length or runtime conclusion.
claims.priority: Classical inverse clearing, linear resultant and Segre/monomial lifting; exact specialized priority unresolved.

claims.title: Exact rank of the even strictly truncated chart
claims.result: The weight matrix has rank N for N=2 modulo 4 and N-1 for N=0 modulo 4 over every field satisfying the exact-order root and nonzero chart hypotheses.
claims.limits: N even, exact order N root, alpha beta delta nonzero, strict integer cutoff a+b<N. Separable-representation rank, not arithmetic runtime.
claims.priority: Classical Gauss-sum parity and truncated Hankel rank ingredients; precise application priority unresolved.

claims.title: Exactly five signed magnetic banks at N equals 5
claims.result: Five explicit legal banks over Q(q) realize negative Fourier at N=5. Together with the accepted support gate and four-bank exclusion, the exact minimum is five in characteristic zero.
claims.limits: Specified signed phase-weighted additive grammar. Generic lemma fixes beta=1 and requires nonzero/distinct/nonsingular assumptions. No positive-characteristic classification, runtime improvement or priority claim.
claims.priority: Classical Gaussian coefficients, moments, interpolation and cyclotomic arithmetic; exact model-specific priority unresolved.

n5.clarification: The final generic lemma explicitly fixes beta=1 in every bank; witness unchanged.

acceptance_scope: Correctness of the stated mathematics and certificates. No worldwide novelty or runtime conclusion.
